usageNote: 日常劝人放松的万能句！stop + doing表示停止某事，语气像朋友拍你肩膀说「别想太多啦！」

examples.en: Stop worrying about writing the perfect email—just send it!
examples.zh: 别再纠结那封邮件写得完不完美了，直接发出去！

examples.en: My teacher told me to stop worrying about writing and just enjoy expressing myself.
examples.zh: 老师让我别总纠结写作，放开来享受表达自己就好。
